@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+# .claude/data/floor.yaml — the one tracked floor source (cycle-129 SDD D-9.2, DEC-0166).
+#
+# The floor is the set of guards, config keys and files no profile, knob or
+# cycle task may weaken. Readers:
+#   - .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh and tests/unit/guard-origins.bats: the
+#     `floor: true` rows of .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml equal floor_guards.
+#   - tests/unit/floor-snapshot.bats: every floor_files entry (and the corpus
+#     rows named under floor_corpus) is byte-identical to origin/main.
+#   - tests/unit/profile-floor.bats (Sprint 2): profiles.yaml names no floor_keys.
+# Both bats suites pin this file's sha256; an edit fails until the pin is
+# deliberately updated in the same change (see the FLOOR_SHA256 constant).
+schema_version: 1
+
+floor_guards:
+  - fence:FR-1.2b
+  - fence:FR-SZ
+  - fence:FR-SZ-COPY
+  - fence:FR-SZ-DD
+  - fence:FR-SZ-EXTRACT
+  - fence:FR-SZ-INPLACE
+  - fence:FR-SZ-INTERP
+  - fence:FR-SZ-LINK
+  - fence:FR-SZ-REDIR
+  - fence:FR-SZ-TEE
+  - fence:FR-SZ2
+  - fence:FR-SZ2-COPY
+  - fence:FR-SZ2-INPLACE
+  - fence:FR-SZ2-REDIR
+  - fence:FR-SZ2-RM
+  - fence:FR-SZ2-TEE
+  - gate:verdict-derive
+  - gate:adversarial-review-gate
+  - policy:permission-deny-list
+  - policy:verdict-one-way-rule
+  - policy:operator-only-commands
+
+floor_keys:
+  - flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled
+  - flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled
+  - "flatline_protocol.*.companion_voice"
+  - "destructive_command_guard.*"
+  - "implement_gate.*"
+  - hounfour.locality
+
+# Paths whose bytes must not change relative to origin/main during a cycle.
+floor_files:
+  - .claude/scripts/verdict-derive.sh
+  - .claude/hooks/safety/adversarial-review-gate.sh
+  - .claude/hooks/settings.deny.json
+  - .claude/data/user-invoked-commands.txt
+
+# Fence-corpus rows (by their `rule` field) that must not change relative to
+# origin/main. A trailing `*` is a prefix match.
+floor_corpus:
+  file: tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/corpus.jsonl
+  rules:
+    - FR-1.2b
+    - "FR-SZ*"
diff --git a/.claude/data/guard-origins.yaml b/.claude/data/guard-origins.yaml

index 00000000..981c9652
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.claude/data/guard-origins.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,905 @@
+# .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml — the guard origin map (cycle-129 SDD D-1.1, §3.1).
+#
+# The one hand-written input of the guard register. `.claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh`
+# enumerates the guards from the repository (hook commands in .claude/settings.json,
+# `# @guard fence:<id>` markers in block-destructive-bash.sh, `# @guard validator:<id>`
+# markers in validate-artifact.sh) and fails (exit 5) when one has no row here, when a
+# row here resolves to nothing, or when a row's origin is empty. It then writes the
+# tracked structural register grimoires/loa/guards.md and the untracked host yield
+# .run/guard-yield.{md,json}. Regenerate after editing: .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh --hooks-table
+#
+# Row fields:
+#   id             hook:<path under .claude/hooks> (scripts outside it: hook:scripts/<name>),
+#                  fence:<pattern id>, validator:<type>.<rule>, gate:<name>, policy:<name>;
+#                  ^[A-Za-z0-9._/:-]+$
+#   kind           hook | fence | validator | gate | policy
+#   class          harness (the model cannot override it) | script (a script checks or
+#                  reports) | prose (the model is asked to comply)
+#   status         active | dormant (armed only by the env var named in knob) |
+#                  telemetry (observes and logs, never refuses)
+#   origin         {kind: kf|issue|finding|cycle|design, ref: <non-empty>}; design rows
+#                  cite the commit that added the guard (git log --follow --diff-filter=A)
+#   knob           the config key or env var that arms, relaxes or disables it, or none
+#   floor          true exactly for the ids in .claude/data/floor.yaml floor_guards
+#   registrations  hook rows: every "<Event>:<matcher>" (or "<Event>" when the
+#                  registration has no matcher) from .claude/settings.json; [] otherwise
+#   script         gate and policy rows: the file that implements it (must exist)
+#   note           one line; the hooks-reference table's Purpose column for hook rows
+schema_version: 1
+guards:
+  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks
+  - id: hook:scripts/upgrade-health-check.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "v1.5.0 692aa617"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["Setup"]
+    note: "Post-install and post-upgrade health check of the framework mount"
+  - id: hook:scripts/check-updates.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "v0.14.0 1f448140"}
+    knob: update_check.enabled
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Notify when a newer framework release exists (cached; LOA_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1 silences it)"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-l6-surface-handoffs.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-098 FR-L6 (#771)"}
+    knob: structured_handoff.enabled
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Surface unread L6 structured handoffs inside a data fence"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-l7-surface-soul.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-098 FR-L7"}
+    knob: soul_identity_doc.enabled
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Surface the L7 soul identity document inside a data fence"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-run-mode-session-title.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active

content.content:
_Aliases_: jack out
 
+**Judgment**: The task kind for work that needs reading and a decision; it ships as prose or a reviewed artifact, and its sprint task line ends with kind: judgment.
+
 **Kaironic**: Stopping at the right moment rather than after a fixed count: an iterative review loop ends when successive passes stop finding material issues.
 _Avoid_: converged
 
 **Karpathy principles**: The four working rules applied on every code-touching turn: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes and goal-driven verification.
 
+**Kind counts**: The release-notes line that counts a cycle's sprint tasks by kind (mechanical, judgment and operator), read from the tagged task lines of its sprint plan.
+
 **Known failure**: A recorded degradation with its symptom, the attempts made and a reading guide, consulted before triage so that prior dead ends are not retried.
 _Aliases_: KF
 
@@ -62,6 +66,10 @@ ## Language
 
 **Map epic**: The epic bead that parents an effort's decision tickets, paired with a map document of its destination, decisions so far, fog and exclusions; run mode never implements it.
 
+**Mechanical**: The task kind for work a script could do reliably; it ships as code with tests, and a review flags a mechanical task delivered as prose the model re-executes.
+
+**Operator**: The human who owns the project and its decisions; as a task kind, work that belongs to that human, which a review flags when it was completed unattended without a decision:unblock ticket or a DEC row.
+
 **Round**: One frontier of interview questions asked together and answered together.
 
 **Run mode**: Unattended execution of a sprint plan with a circuit breaker, wrapping implement, review and audit in a loop. Its states are running, halted and jacked out.
@@ -78,4 +86,6 @@ ## Language
 
 **Voice**: The party a decision or finding is attributed to: the operator, the agent, Flatline or dissent.
 
+**Volume ratio**: The release-notes line that sets a cycle's script lines changed against its prose bytes changed and its model calls; the model-call count is local to the host that ran the cycle.
+
 **Zone**: One of the three permission regions of a repository: the System zone holds the framework and is never edited by hand, the State zone is read and written freely, and the App zone needs confirmation before a write.

diff --git a/.claude/scripts/loa-status.sh b/.claude/scripts/loa-status.sh

--- a/.claude/scripts/loa-status.sh

@@ -689,6 +689,10 @@ main() {
     echo "───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────"
     display_providers_section
 
+    # Guards line (cycle-129 FR-1, SDD D-1.5): register counts and the host yield.
+    echo ""
+    display_guards_line
+
     # Agent-Network Primitives section (cycle-098 Sprint 1C, SDD §4.4).
     echo ""
     echo "───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────"
@@ -927,6 +931,33 @@ display_providers_section() {
   return 0
 }
 
+# cycle-129 FR-1 (SDD D-1.5): one Guards line. Counts come from the tracked structural
+# register (grimoires/loa/guards.md), the 30-day yield from the untracked
+# .run/guard-yield.json; nothing is recomputed here. Bats-gated seams:
+# LOA_STATUS_GUARDS_FILE and LOA_STATUS_GUARD_YIELD_FILE.
+display_guards_line() {
+  local reg="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/guards.md" yf="$PROJECT_ROOT/.run/guard-yield.json"
+  local hint="regenerate: .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh" n m d y
+  if [[ -n "${BATS_TEST_FILENAME:-}${BATS_VERSION:-}" ]]; then
+    [[ -n "${LOA_STATUS_GUARDS_FILE:-}" ]] && reg="$LOA_STATUS_GUARDS_FILE"
+    [[ -n "${LOA_STATUS_GUARD_YIELD_FILE:-}" ]] && yf="$LOA_STATUS_GUARD_YIELD_FILE"
+  fi
+  if [[ ! -f "$reg" ]]; then
+    echo -e "${BOLD}Guards:${NC} no register (grimoires/loa/guards.md) · $hint"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  n=$(sed -n 's/^- guards: \([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$reg" | head -1)
+  m=$(sed -n 's/^- guards_without_origin: \([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$reg" | head -1)
+  d=$(sed -n 's/^- dormant: \([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$reg" | head -1)
+  local counts="${n:-?} (${m:-?} without origin, ${d:-?} dormant)"
+  if [[ -f "$yf" ]] && y=$(jq -er '"\(.window_days | tonumber) d: \(.totals.real_blocks_30d | tonumber) real blocks, \(.totals.likely_fp_30d | tonumber) likely FP · scope \(.scope | tostring | gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]"; ""))"' "$yf" 2>/dev/null); then
+    echo -e "${BOLD}Guards:${NC} $counts · $y · $hint"
+  else
+    echo -e "${BOLD}Guards:${NC} $counts · 30 d: no yield file (.run/guard-yield.json) · $hint"
+  fi
+  return 0
+}

+"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).

content.content:

python3 -I - "$manifest" "$review" "$executor" <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
manifest_path, review_path, executor_path = sys.argv[1:4]
man = json.load(open(manifest_path))
text = open(review_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()

# path:line[-line] citations. Path = something with a file extension; the
# optional trailing range keeps `file.py:10-14` in one token, and the comma
# list after it (`:776,807`) belongs to the same path. A bare `:N` (or
# `head:N` / `base:N`) not glued to a word binds to the most recent path.
# a range dash is unspaced (`a.sh:12 - 40 rows` is prose, not a range) and
# every number ends at a boundary: no letter or digit, and no hyphen / en dash
# before another digit, after it (dates such as 2026-10-05 / 2026–10–05 never
# parse; an open `:369-...` still cites 369) — sprint-250 review run 2, #13
RNG = r'(\d{1,6})(?:[-–](\d{1,6}))?(?![A-Za-z0-9]|[-–]\d)'
CITE = re.compile(
    r'(?P<path>[A-Za-z0-9_./+()-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6})[`*)]{0,3}:(?P<first>' + RNG
    + r'(?:[ \t]*,[ \t]*' + RNG + r')*)'
    # head:N / base:N keep the 1.1.0 boundary set ("head:40" binds); the JSON
    # punctuation set, plus a CLOSING backtick (one after a token character:
    # `rows`:40, `"high"`:3), guards only the fully bare :N — an opening
    # backtick (`:7`, (`:212`)) still binds (RG-13) — run 2, #14
    r'|(?:(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:])(?:head|base)|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:"\'{}\[\]*])(?<![A-Za-z0-9_"\'}\]]`)):(?P<bare>' + RNG + r')')
ONE = re.compile(RNG)
cites = []
last = None

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# Path-scoped rule files (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-3.1, DEC-0129): stash-safety.md and
+# skill-invariants.md carry `paths:` frontmatter, the frontmatter parses, and every glob
+# matches at least one tracked file of the kind the rule is about (git pathspec glob
+# semantics: `**` spans directories, `*` stays inside one).
+
+setup() {
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    RULES="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/rules"
+    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
+}
+
+# The YAML between the first two '---' lines (empty when the file has none).
+frontmatter() { awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit } /^---$/ { if (n++) exit; next } n' "$1"; }
+globs() { frontmatter "$1" | yq eval '.paths[]' -; }
+tracked() { git -C "$PROJECT_ROOT" ls-files -- ":(glob)$1"; }
+
+@test "RP-1 both rule files open with frontmatter that parses and lists string globs under paths:" {
+    local f n
+    for f in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
+        [ "$(head -1 "$RULES/$f")" = "---" ] || { echo "$f has no frontmatter"; return 1; }
+        frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.' - >/dev/null || { echo "$f frontmatter does not parse"; return 1; }
+        [ "$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.paths | type' -)" = "!!seq" ]
+        n="$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.paths | length' -)"
+        [ "$n" -ge 1 ]
+        [ "$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '[.paths[] | select(type != "!!str")] | length' -)" -eq 0 ]
+    done
+}
+
+@test "RP-2 the globs are the ones the SDD names" {
+    [ "$(globs "$RULES/stash-safety.md" | tr '\n' ' ')" = '**/*.sh **/*.bats .claude/scripts/** .claude/hooks/** ' ]
+    [ "$(globs "$RULES/skill-invariants.md" | tr '\n' ' ')" = '.claude/skills/**/SKILL.md .claude/agents/** .claude/data/agent-types.yaml .claude/scripts/validate-skill-capabilities.sh ' ]

+    done < <(globs "$RULES/stash-safety.md")
+}
+
+@test "RP-4 every skill-invariants glob matches a tracked skill, agent definition or capability file" {
+    local g hits
+    while IFS= read -r g; do
+        hits="$(tracked "$g" | grep -E '(^\.claude/skills/[^/]+/SKILL\.md$|^\.claude/agents/[^/]+\.md$|^\.claude/data/agent-types\.yaml$|^\.claude/scripts/validate-skill-capabilities\.sh$)' | head -1)"

+    done < <(globs "$RULES/skill-invariants.md")

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
     3	
     4	Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
     5	suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
     6	<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
     7	`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
     8	
     9	Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
    10	the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
    11	findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
    12	findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
    13	bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
    14	the verdict and the missed labels.
    15	
    16	Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
    17	  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
    18	                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
    19	                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
    20	                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
    21	                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
    22	  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
    23	                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
    24	  no recall loss  every rule holds:
    25	                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
    26	                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
    27	                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
    28	An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
    29	
    30	Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
    31	given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
    32	"""
    33	import argparse
    34	import datetime
    35	import json
    36	import os
    37	import random
    38	import sys
    39	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    40	
    41	
    42	def load_yaml_subset(path):
    43	    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
    44	    import subprocess
    45	    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    46	    return json.loads(out)
    47	
    48	
    49	def read_jsonl(path):
    50	    rows = []
    51	    if not os.path.isfile(path):
    52	        return rows
    53	    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    54	        for line in fh:
    55	            line = line.strip()
    56	            if line:
    57	                try:
    58	                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
    59	                except ValueError:
    60	                    continue
    61	    return rows
    62	
    63	
    64	def mean(xs):
    65	    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    66	    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
    67	
    68	
    69	def fmt(x, nd=3):
    70	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
    71	
    72	
    73	def recall_details(row):
    74	    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
    75	        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
    76	            return g["details"]
    77	    return None
    78	
    79	
    80	def tokens(row):
    81	    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
    82	    if not u:
    83	        return None
    84	    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
    85	               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
    86	
    87	
    88	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    89	    if not sorted_xs:
    90	        return None
    91	    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
    92	    return sorted_xs[k]
    93	
    94	
    95	def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
    96	    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
    97	    if not deltas:
    98	        return None, None
    99	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   100	    n = len(deltas)
   101	    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
   102	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   103	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
   104	
   105	
   106	class Arm:
   107	    def __init__(self, arm_id):
   108	        self.id = arm_id
   109	        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
   110	        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
   111	        self.cited = 0
   112	        self.refuted = 0
   113	        self.tokens = []
   114	        self.models = set()
   115	        self.sources = set()
   116	        self.done = 0
   117	        self.errors = 0
   118	        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
   119	        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
   120	        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
   121	        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
   122	
   123	    def add(self, row):
   124	        if row.get("status") != "completed":
   125	            self.errors += 1
   126	            return
   127	        d = recall_details(row)
   128	        if d is None:
   129	            self.errors += 1
   130	            return
   131	        self.done += 1
   132	        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
   133	        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
   134	        if d.get("recall") is not None:
   135	            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
   136	        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:
   137	            self.cited += int(d.get("findings_cited") or 0)
   138	            self.refuted += int(d.get("findings_refuted") or 0)
   139	        t = tokens(row)
   140	        if t is not None:
   141	            self.tokens.append(t)
   142	        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
   143	        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
   144	        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
   145	            if out:
   146	                self.models.add(mid)
   147	        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
   148	        if fb:
   149	            self.fallback_trials += 1
   150	            for x in fb:
   151	                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
   152	        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
   153	        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
   154	            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   155	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   156	        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
   157	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   158	
   159	    def defect_fixtures(self):
   160	        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
   161	
   162	    def fixture_means(self):
   163	        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
   164	
   165	    def trial_means(self):
   166	        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
   167	        for f in self.defect_fixtures():
   168	            for t, r in self.cells[f]:
   169	                by_trial[t].append(r)
   170	        return {t: mean(v) for t, v in sorted(by_trial.items())}
   171	
   172	    def refuted_share(self):
   173	        return self.refuted / self.cited if self.cited else None
   174	
   175	
   176	def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
   177	    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
   178	    status = {}
   179	    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")
   180	    if os.path.isfile(sp):
   181	        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   182	    spec = load_yaml_subset(os.path.join(suites_dir, f"{suite}.yaml"))
   183	    ab = spec.get("ab") or {}
   184	    th = ab.get("threshold") or {}
   185	    arm_meta = {a["id"]: a for a in ab.get("arms") or []}
   186	    trials_required = int(th.get("trials_required", 3))
   187	    max_drop = float(th.get("mean_recall_max_drop", 0.10))
   188	    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
   189	    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
   190	    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
   191	    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
   192	    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))
   193	
   194	    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
   195	    arms = {}
   196	    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
   197	        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
   198	        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
   199	        if not os.path.isfile(mp):
   200	            continue
   201	        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))
   202	        if m.get("dry_run"):
   203	            continue
   204	        manifests.append(m)
   205	        planned_fx.update(m.get("fixtures") or [])
   206	        for a in m.get("arms") or []:
   207	            if a not in planned_arms:
   208	                planned_arms.append(a)
   209	            arm = arms.setdefault(a, Arm(a))
   210	            for row in read_jsonl(os.path.join(bdir, a, "results.jsonl")):
   211	                arm.add(row)
   212	    order = [a for a in arm_meta if a in arms] + [a for a in planned_arms if a not in arm_meta]
   213	    state = status.get("state", "unknown")
   214	    complete = state == "complete"
   215	
   216	    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
   217	    out_lines.append("")
   218	    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
   219	    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
   220	    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})
   221	    out_lines.append(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(f'`{s[:12]}`' for s in srcs if s) or 'n/a'}; executor model requested: {', '.join(f'`{x}`' for x in models if x) or 'n/a'}")
   222	    out_lines.append(f"- planned fixtures ({len(planned_fx)}): {', '.join(sorted(planned_fx)) or 'none'}")
   223	    out_lines.append(f"- threshold: trials_required {trials_required}, mean_recall_max_drop {max_drop}, "
   224	                     f"min_trial_recall_max_drop {min_trial_drop}, refuted_share_max_rise {refuted_rise}, "
   225	                     f"bootstrap {bs.get('method', 'percentile')} {level} over {bs.get('resample', 'fixtures')} x{iterations}")
   226	    out_lines.append("")
   227	
   228	    base = arms.get("baseline")
   229	    base_fm = base.fixture_means() if base else {}
   230	    base_tm = base.trial_means() if base else {}
   231	    base_spread = (max(base_tm.values()) - min(base_tm.values())) if base_tm else None
   232	    base_min = min(base_tm.values()) if base_tm else None
   233	    base_ref = base.refuted_share() if base else None
   234	
   235	    def coverage_gaps(arm):
   236	        gaps = []
   237	        for fx in sorted(planned_fx):
   238	            planted = arm.planted.get(fx)
   239	            n = len(arm.cells.get(fx, [])) if planted else 0
   240	            if planted == 0:
   241	                continue  # a clean fixture carries no recall; refuted share only
   242	            if n < trials_required:
   243	                gaps.append(f"{fx} {n}/{trials_required}")
   244	        return gaps
   245	
   246	    header = ("| arm | trials done | errors | mean recall | min | max | spread | drop vs baseline | "
   247	              f"{int(level * 100)}% CI of drop | refuted share | tokens/call | verdict |")
   248	    out_lines.append(header)
   249	    out_lines.append("|" + "---|" * 12)
   250	    details = []
   251	    verdicts = {}
   252	    for a in order:
   253	        arm = arms[a]
   254	        fm = arm.fixture_means()
   255	        tm = arm.trial_means()
   256	        m = mean(list(fm.values()))
   257	        mn = min(tm.values()) if tm else None
   258	        mx = max(tm.values()) if tm else None
   259	        spread = (mx - mn) if tm else None
   260	        rs = arm.refuted_share()
   261	        tok = mean(arm.tokens)
   262	        drop = lo = hi = None
   263	        reasons = []
   264	        if a == "baseline":
   265	            verdict = "(reference)"
   266	        else:
   267	            common = sorted(set(fm) & set(base_fm))
   268	            deltas = [base_fm[f] - fm[f] for f in common]
   269	            drop = mean(deltas)
   270	            lo, hi = bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, f"{suite}:{a}")
   271	            if partial:
   272	                reasons.append("--partial report")
   273	            if not complete:
   274	                reasons.append(f"run state is {state}")
   275	            if base is None:
   276	                reasons.append("no baseline arm")
   277	            gaps = coverage_gaps(arm) + ([f"baseline {g}" for g in coverage_gaps(base)] if base else [])
   278	            if gaps:
   279	                reasons.append("coverage: " + ", ".join(gaps[:8]) + (" …" if len(gaps) > 8 else ""))
   280	            mods = {x for x in arm.models | (base.models if base else set()) if x}
   281	            if len(mods) > 1:
   282	                reasons.append("model skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(mods)))
   283	            srcs_a = {x for x in arm.sources | (base.sources if base else set()) if x}
   284	            if len(srcs_a) > 1:
   285	                reasons.append("source skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(s[:12] for s in srcs_a)))
   286	            if not deltas:
   287	                reasons.append("no defect fixture graded in both arms")
   288	            if reasons:
   289	                verdict = "inconclusive"
   290	            else:
   291	                violated, refuted_violated = [], False
   292	                if hi is None or hi > max_drop:
   293	                    violated.append(f"drop CI upper {fmt(hi)} > {max_drop}")
   294	                if mn is None or base_min is None or mn < base_min - min_trial_drop:
   295	                    violated.append(f"min trial {fmt(mn)} < baseline min {fmt(base_min)} - {min_trial_drop}")
   296	                if rs is not None and base_ref is not None and rs > base_ref + refuted_rise:
   297	                    violated.append(f"refuted share {fmt(rs)} > baseline {fmt(base_ref)} + {refuted_rise}")
   298	                    refuted_violated = True
   299	                if not violated:
   300	                    verdict = "no recall loss"
   301	                elif (not refuted_violated and drop is not None and base_spread is not None
   302	                      and abs(drop) <= base_spread):
   303	                    # only recall rules failed and the mean moved less than the
   304	                    # baseline moves against itself: too small a change to name
   305	                    verdict = "inconclusive"
   306	                    reasons.append("rule violated (" + "; ".join(violated) + f") but |drop| {fmt(abs(drop))} "
   307	                                   f"<= baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: no change can be named")
   308	                else:
   309	                    verdict = "recall loss"
   310	                    reasons.extend(violated)
   311	            if (arm_meta.get(a) or {}).get("informational"):
   312	                verdict += " (informational: yield only)"
   313	        verdicts[a] = verdict
   314	        out_lines.append(
   315	            f"| `{a}` | {arm.done} | {arm.errors} | {fmt(m)} | {fmt(mn)} | {fmt(mx)} | {fmt(spread)} | "
   316	            f"{fmt(drop)} | {('[' + fmt(lo) + ', ' + fmt(hi) + ']') if lo is not None else 'n/a'} | "
   317	            f"{fmt(rs)} | {('%.0f' % tok) if tok is not None else 'n/a'} | **{verdict}** |")
   318	        if arm.fallback_trials:
   319	            reasons.append(f"{arm.fallback_trials}/{arm.done} trial(s) fell back to another model on a safeguard refusal: "
   320	                           + ", ".join(f"{k} x{n}" for k, n in arm.fallback_kinds.most_common()))
   321	        if reasons:
   322	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: " + "; ".join(reasons))
   323	        if a != "baseline" and drop is not None and base_spread is not None:
   324	            named = "named" if abs(drop) > base_spread else "not named (within the baseline's own spread)"
   325	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: mean drop {fmt(drop)} vs baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: change {named}")
   326	    out_lines.append("")
   327	    if details:
   328	        out_lines.append("Verdict notes:")
   329	        out_lines.extend(details)
   330	        out_lines.append("")
   331	    out_lines.append("### Missed labels")
   332	    out_lines.append("")
   333	    for a in order:
   334	        arm = arms[a]
   335	        items = sorted(arm.missed.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
   336	        if not items:
   337	            out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: none")
   338	            continue
   339	        shown = ", ".join(f"{fx}:{lbl} ({n}/{arm.seen[(fx, lbl)]})" for (fx, lbl), n in items[:40])
   340	        more = f" … and {len(items) - 40} more" if len(items) > 40 else ""
   341	        out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: {shown}{more}")
   342	    out_lines.append("")
   343	    return state, verdicts
   344	
   345	
   346	def main():
   347	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   348	    ap.add_argument("--results-root", required=True)
   349	    ap.add_argument("--suites-dir", required=True)
   350	    ap.add_argument("--suites", default="")
   351	    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
   352	    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
   353	    ap.add_argument("--date", default=datetime.date.today().isoformat())
   354	    args = ap.parse_args()
   355	
   356	    suites = [s for s in args.suites.split(",") if s] or sorted(
   357	        s for s in ("review-recall", "audit-recall") if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)))
   358	    if not suites:
   359	        print(f"arms-report: no suite results under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
   360	        return 2
   361	    for s in suites:
   362	        if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)):
   363	            print(f"arms-report: no results for suite {s} under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
   364	            return 2
   365	        st = {}
   366	        sp = os.path.join(args.results_root, s, "STATUS.json")
   367	        if os.path.isfile(sp):
   368	            st = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   369	        if st.get("state") != "complete" and not args.partial:
   370	            print(f"arms-report: {s} STATUS.json state is {st.get('state', 'missing')!r}, not 'complete'; "
   371	                  "refusing to write a verdict report (pass --partial for an inconclusive interim report)",
   372	                  file=sys.stderr)
   373	            return 1
   374	
   375	    lines = [f"# Control-arm report — {args.date}", ""]
   376	    if args.partial:
   377	        lines += ["> **PARTIAL REPORT.** Written with `--partial` before every run completed: every verdict "
   378	                  "below reads `inconclusive` and none licenses a deletion (SDD D-2.3).", ""]
   379	    lines += ["Generated by `evals/harness/report.sh --arms` from `" + args.results_root + "`. "
   380	              "Recall is graded by `recall-vs-defects.sh` (planted defects and approved record labels); "
   381	              "refuted share counts cited findings that match neither a label nor a fix region. "
   382	              "A deletion that relies on an arm requires the lead to read that arm's missed labels and record the reading.", ""]
   383	    for s in suites:
   384	        suite_report(args.results_root, args.suites_dir, s, args.partial, lines)
   385	    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.out)), exist_ok=True)
   386	    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
   387	        fh.write("\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")

   389	    return 0

     7	`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
     8	
     9	Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
    10	the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
    11	findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
    12	findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
    13	bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
    14	the verdict and the missed labels.
    15	
    16	Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
    17	  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
    18	                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
    19	                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
    20	                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
    21	                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
    22	  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
    23	                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
    24	  no recall loss  every rule holds:
    25	                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
    26	                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
    27	                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
    28	An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
    29	
    30	Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
    31	given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
    32	"""
    33	import argparse
    34	import datetime
    35	import json
    36	import os
    37	import random
    38	import sys
    39	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    40

    42	def load_yaml_subset(path):
    43	    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
    44	    import subprocess
    45	    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    46	    return json.loads(out)
    47

    49	def read_jsonl(path):
    50	    rows = []
    51	    if not os.path.isfile(path):
    52	        return rows
    53	    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    54	        for line in fh:
    55	            line = line.strip()
    56	            if line:
    57	                try:
    58	                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
    59	                except ValueError:
    60	                    continue
    61	    return rows

    64	def mean(xs):
    65	    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    66	    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
    67	
    68	
    69	def fmt(x, nd=3):
    70	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
    71	
    72	
    73	def recall_details(row):
    74	    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
    75	        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
    76	            return g["details"]
    77	    return None
    78	
    79	
    80	def tokens(row):
    81	    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
    82	    if not u:
    83	        return None
    84	    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
    85	               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
    86	
    87	
    88	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    89	    if not sorted_xs:
    90	        return None
    91	    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
    92	    return sorted_xs[k]
    93	
    94	
    95	def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
    96	    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
    97	    if not deltas:
    98	        return None, None
    99	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   100	    n = len(deltas)
   101	    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
   102	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   103	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
   104	
   105	
   106	class Arm:
   107	    def __init__(self, arm_id):
   108	        self.id = arm_id
   109	        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
   110	        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
   111	        self.cited = 0
   112	        self.refuted = 0
   113	        self.tokens = []
   114	        self.models = set()
   115	        self.sources = set()
   116	        self.done = 0
   117	        self.errors = 0
   118	        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
   119	        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
   120	        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
   121	        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
   122	
   123	    def add(self, row):
   124	        if row.get("status") != "completed":
   125	            self.errors += 1
   126	            return
   127	        d = recall_details(row)
   128	        if d is None:
   129	            self.errors += 1
   130	            return
   131	        self.done += 1
   132	        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
   133	        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
   134	        if d.get("recall") is not None:
   135	            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
   136	        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:
   137	            self.cited += int(d.get("findings_cited") or 0)
   138	            self.refuted += int(d.get("findings_refuted") or 0)
   139	        t = tokens(row)
   140	        if t is not None:
   141	            self.tokens.append(t)
   142	        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
   143	        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
   144	        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
   145	            if out:
   146	                self.models.add(mid)
   147	        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
   148	        if fb:
   149	            self.fallback_trials += 1
   150	            for x in fb:
   151	                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
   152	        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
   153	        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
   154	            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   155	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   156	        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
   157	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   158	
   159	    def defect_fixtures(self):
   160	        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
   161	
   162	    def fixture_means(self):
   163	        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
   164	
   165	    def trial_means(self):
   166	        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
   167	        for f in self.defect_fixtures():
   168	            for t, r in self.cells[f]:
   169	                by_trial[t].append(r)
   170	        return {t: mean(v) for t, v in sorted(by_trial.items())}
   171	
   172	    def refuted_share(self):
   173	        return self.refuted / self.cited if self.cited else None
   174

   176	def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
   177	    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
   178	    status = {}
   179	    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")
   180	    if os.path.isfile(sp):
   181	        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   182	    spec = load_yaml_subset(os.path.join(suites_dir, f"{suite}.yaml"))
   183	    ab = spec.get("ab") or {}
   184	    th = ab.get("threshold") or {}
   185	    arm_meta = {a["id"]: a for a in ab.get("arms") or []}
   186	    trials_required = int(th.get("trials_required", 3))
   187	    max_drop = float(th.get("mean_recall_max_drop", 0.10))
   188	    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
   189	    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
   190	    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
   191	    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
   192	    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))
   193	
   194	    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
   195	    arms = {}
   196	    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
   197	        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
   198	        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
   199	        if not os.path.isfile(mp):
   200	            continue
   201	        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))
   202	        if m.get("dry_run"):
   203	            continue
   204	        manifests.append(m)
   205	        planned_fx.update(m.get("fixtures") or [])
   206	        for a in m.get("arms") or []:
   207	            if a not in planned_arms:
   208	                planned_arms.append(a)
   209	            arm = arms.setdefault(a, Arm(a))
   210	            for row in read_jsonl(os.path.join(bdir, a, "results.jsonl")):
   211	                arm.add(row)
   212	    order = [a for a in arm_meta if a in arms] + [a for a in planned_arms if a not in arm_meta]
   213	    state = status.get("state", "unknown")
   214	    complete = state == "complete"
   215	
   216	    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
   217	    out_lines.append("")
   218	    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
   219	    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
   220	    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})
   221	    out_lines.append(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(f'`{s[:12]}`' for s in srcs if s) or 'n/a'}; executor model requested: {', '.join(f'`{x}`' for x in models if x) or 'n/a'}")
   222	    out_lines.append(f"- planned fixtures ({len(planned_fx)}): {', '.join(sorted(planned_fx)) or 'none'}")
   223	    out_lines.append(f"- threshold: trials_required {trials_required}, mean_recall_max_drop {max_drop}, "
   224	                     f"min_trial_recall_max_drop {min_trial_drop}, refuted_share_max_rise {refuted_rise}, "
   225	                     f"bootstrap {bs.get('method', 'percentile')} {level} over {bs.get('resample', 'fixtures')} x{iterations}")
   226	    out_lines.append("")
   227	
   228	    base = arms.get("baseline")
   229	    base_fm = base.fixture_means() if base else {}
   230	    base_tm = base.trial_means() if base else {}
   231	    base_spread = (max(base_tm.values()) - min(base_tm.values())) if base_tm else None
   232	    base_min = min(base_tm.values()) if base_tm else None
   233	    base_ref = base.refuted_share() if base else None
   234	
   235	    def coverage_gaps(arm):
   236	        gaps = []
   237	        for fx in sorted(planned_fx):
   238	            planted = arm.planted.get(fx)
   239	            n = len(arm.cells.get(fx, [])) if planted else 0
   240	            if planted == 0:
   241	                continue  # a clean fixture carries no recall; refuted share only
   242	            if n < trials_required:
   243	                gaps.append(f"{fx} {n}/{trials_required}")
   244	        return gaps
   245	
   246	    header = ("| arm | trials done | errors | mean recall | min | max | spread | drop vs baseline | "
   247	              f"{int(level * 100)}% CI of drop | refuted share | tokens/call | verdict |")
   248	    out_lines.append(header)
   249	    out_lines.append("|" + "---|" * 12)
   250	    details = []
   251	    verdicts = {}
   252	    for a in order:
   253	        arm = arms[a]
   254	        fm = arm.fixture_means()
   255	        tm = arm.trial_means()
   256	        m = mean(list(fm.values()))
   257	        mn = min(tm.values()) if tm else None
   258	        mx = max(tm.values()) if tm else None
   259	        spread = (mx - mn) if tm else None
   260	        rs = arm.refuted_share()
   261	        tok = mean(arm.tokens)
   262	        drop = lo = hi = None
   263	        reasons = []
   264	        if a == "baseline":
   265	            verdict = "(reference)"
   266	        else:
   267	            common = sorted(set(fm) & set(base_fm))
   268	            deltas = [base_fm[f] - fm[f] for f in common]
   269	            drop = mean(deltas)
   270	            lo, hi = bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, f"{suite}:{a}")
   271	            if partial:
   272	                reasons.append("--partial report")
   273	            if not complete:
   274	                reasons.append(f"run state is {state}")
   275	            if base is None:
   276	                reasons.append("no baseline arm")
   277	            gaps = coverage_gaps(arm) + ([f"baseline {g}" for g in coverage_gaps(base)] if base else [])
   278	            if gaps:
   279	                reasons.append("coverage: " + ", ".join(gaps[:8]) + (" …" if len(gaps) > 8 else ""))
   280	            mods = {x for x in arm.models | (base.models if base else set()) if x}
   281	            if len(mods) > 1:
   282	                reasons.append("model skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(mods)))
   283	            srcs_a = {x for x in arm.sources | (base.sources if base else set()) if x}
   284	            if len(srcs_a) > 1:
   285	                reasons.append("source skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(s[:12] for s in srcs_a)))
   286	            if not deltas:
   287	                reasons.append("no defect fixture graded in both arms")
   288	            if reasons:
   289	                verdict = "inconclusive"
   290	            else:
   291	                violated, refuted_violated = [], False
   292	                if hi is None or hi > max_drop:
   293	                    violated.append(f"drop CI upper {fmt(hi)} > {max_drop}")
   294	                if mn is None or base_min is None or mn < base_min - min_trial_drop:
   295	                    violated.append(f"min trial {fmt(mn)} < baseline min {fmt(base_min)} - {min_trial_drop}")
   296	                if rs is not None and base_ref is not None and rs > base_ref + refuted_rise:
   297	                    violated.append(f"refuted share {fmt(rs)} > baseline {fmt(base_ref)} + {refuted_rise}")
   298	                    refuted_violated = True
   299	                if not violated:
   300	                    verdict = "no recall loss"
   301	                elif (not refuted_violated and drop is not None and base_spread is not None
   302	                      and abs(drop) <= base_spread):
   303	                    # only recall rules failed and the mean moved less than the
   304	                    # baseline moves against itself: too small a change to name
   305	                    verdict = "inconclusive"
   306	                    reasons.append("rule violated (" + "; ".join(violated) + f") but |drop| {fmt(abs(drop))} "
   307	                                   f"<= baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: no change can be named")
   308	                else:
   309	                    verdict = "recall loss"
   310	                    reasons.extend(violated)
   311	            if (arm_meta.get(a) or {}).get("informational"):
   312	                verdict += " (informational: yield only)"
   313	        verdicts[a] = verdict
   314	        out_lines.append(
   315	            f"| `{a}` | {arm.done} | {arm.errors} | {fmt(m)} | {fmt(mn)} | {fmt(mx)} | {fmt(spread)} | "
   316	            f"{fmt(drop)} | {('[' + fmt(lo) + ', ' + fmt(hi) + ']') if lo is not None else 'n/a'} | "
   317	            f"{fmt(rs)} | {('%.0f' % tok) if tok is not None else 'n/a'} | **{verdict}** |")
   318	        if arm.fallback_trials:
   319	            reasons.append(f"{arm.fallback_trials}/{arm.done} trial(s) fell back to another model on a safeguard refusal: "
   320	                           + ", ".join(f"{k} x{n}" for k, n in arm.fallback_kinds.most_common()))
   321	        if reasons:
   322	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: " + "; ".join(reasons))
   323	        if a != "baseline" and drop is not None and base_spread is not None:
   324	            named = "named" if abs(drop) > base_spread else "not named (within the baseline's own spread)"
   325	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: mean drop {fmt(drop)} vs baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: change {named}")
   326	    out_lines.append("")
   327	    if details:
   328	        out_lines.append("Verdict notes:")
   329	        out_lines.extend(details)
   330	        out_lines.append("")
   331	    out_lines.append("### Missed labels")
   332	    out_lines.append("")
   333	    for a in order:
   334	        arm = arms[a]
   335	        items = sorted(arm.missed.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
   336	        if not items:
   337	            out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: none")
   338	            continue
   339	        shown = ", ".join(f"{fx}:{lbl} ({n}/{arm.seen[(fx, lbl)]})" for (fx, lbl), n in items[:40])
   340	        more = f" … and {len(items) - 40} more" if len(items) > 40 else ""
   341	        out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: {shown}{more}")
   342	    out_lines.append("")
   343	    return state, verdicts
   344	
   345	
   346	def main():
   347	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   348	    ap.add_argument("--results-root", required=True)
   349	    ap.add_argument("--suites-dir", required=True)
   350	    ap.add_argument("--suites", default="")
   351	    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
   352	    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
   353	    ap.add_argument("--date", default=datetime.date.today().isoformat())
   354	    args = ap.parse_args()
   355	
   356	    suites = [s for s in args.suites.split(",") if s] or sorted(
   357	        s for s in ("review-recall", "audit-recall") if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)))
   358	    if not suites:
   359	        print(f"arms-report: no suite results under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
   360	        return 2
   361	    for s in suites:
   362	        if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)):
   363	            print(f"arms-report: no results for suite {s} under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
   364	            return 2
   365	        st = {}
   366	        sp = os.path.join(args.results_root, s, "STATUS.json")
   367	        if os.path.isfile(sp):
   368	            st = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   369	        if st.get("state") != "complete" and not args.partial:
   370	            print(f"arms-report: {s} STATUS.json state is {st.get('state', 'missing')!r}, not 'complete'; "
   371	                  "refusing to write a verdict report (pass --partial for an inconclusive interim report)",
   372	                  file=sys.stderr)
   373	            return 1
   374	
   375	    lines = [f"# Control-arm report — {args.date}", ""]
   376	    if args.partial:
   377	        lines += ["> **PARTIAL REPORT.** Written with `--partial` before every run completed: every verdict "
   378	                  "below reads `inconclusive` and none licenses a deletion (SDD D-2.3).", ""]
   379	    lines += ["Generated by `evals/harness/report.sh --arms` from `" + args.results_root + "`. "
   380	              "Recall is graded by `recall-vs-defects.sh` (planted defects and approved record labels); "
   381	              "refuted share counts cited findings that match neither a label nor a fix region. "
   382	              "A deletion that relies on an arm requires the lead to read that arm's missed labels and record the reading.", ""]
   383	    for s in suites:
   384	        suite_report(args.results_root, args.suites_dir, s, args.partial, lines)
   385	    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.out)), exist_ok=True)
   386	    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
   387	        fh.write("\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")
   388	    print(args.out)
   389	    return 0
   390	
   391	
   392	if __name__ == "__main__":
   393	    sys.exit(main())

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
     4	#
     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
     6	# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
     7	# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
     8	#
     9	# Usage:
    10	#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
    37	#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
    38	#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
    39	#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
    40	#
    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
    42	#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
    43	#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
    44	#
    45	# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
    46	# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
    47	# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).

   428	PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
   429	reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
   430	  local i
   431	  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
   432	    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
   433	      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then

   438	        break

   442	  done

   444	}

   462	else
   463	  set_state partial; log "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"; exit 1
   464	fi

   275	  jq -n --arg state "$STATE" --argjson per "$per" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model "$MODEL" \
   276	    --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" \
   277	    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, state: $state, per_arm: $per,
   278	      source_commit: $src, model_id: $model, started: $started, finished: $finished}' > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp"
   279	  mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
   280	  aggregate_status
   281	}
   282	
   283	# The suite-level STATUS.json merges every batch: counters add per arm; the
   284	# state is failed > running > partial > complete; source/model must agree.
   285	aggregate_status() {
   286	  local agg="$SUITE_DIR/STATUS.json" lockd="$SUITE_DIR/.status.lock" n=0
   287	  until mkdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null; do n=$((n + 1)); [[ $n -gt 50 ]] && return 0; sleep 0.1; done
   288	  # shellcheck disable=SC2046
   289	  jq -s --arg suite "$SUITE" '
   290	    def rank: {"failed": 4, "running": 3, "partial": 2, "complete": 1}[.] // 4;
   291	    (map(.state) | max_by(rank)) as $state |
   292	    {schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, state: $state,
   293	     batches: map({batch, state, started, finished}),
   294	     per_arm: (reduce (.[] | .per_arm | to_entries[]) as $e ({};
   295	        .[$e.key] |= {trials_done: ((.trials_done // 0) + $e.value.trials_done),
   296	                      trials_failed: ((.trials_failed // 0) + $e.value.trials_failed),
   297	                      trials_planned: ((.trials_planned // 0) + $e.value.trials_planned)})),
   298	     source_commit: (map(.source_commit) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   299	     model_id: (map(.model_id) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   300	     started: (map(.started) | min), finished: (if $state == "running" then null else (map(.finished) | max) end)}' \
   301	    $(find "$SUITE_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name STATUS.json | sort) > "$agg.tmp" 2>/dev/null \
   302	    && mv "$agg.tmp" "$agg"
   303	  rmdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null || true
   304	}
   305	set_state() { STATE="$1"; write_status; }
   306	
   307	# --- one trial (runs in a background job; writes its row to $JOBS_DIR/<id>.row)
   308	is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
   309	  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
   310	  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
   311	  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
   312	  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
   313	  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
   314	  grep -qiE 'rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|network|socket hang up|5[0-9][0-9] ' \
   315	    "$err" "$out" 2>/dev/null && return 0
   316	  return 1
   317	}
   318	
   319	run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>
   320	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" fx="$3" trial="$4"
   321	  local task="$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$fx.yaml" task_id="$TASK_PREFIX-$fx"
   322	  local run_id="arms-$SUITE-$BATCH" attempt=0 ws="" trial_id status="error" err_json='null'
   323	  local graders='[]' composite='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}' executor='null'
   324	  local start_ms end_ms per_trial ex_rc
   325	  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
   326	  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
   327	  if ! verify_corpus "$fx" >"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift"; then
   328	    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
   329	  fi
   330	  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
   331	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
   332	    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
   333	    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
   334	      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
   335	    ex_rc=0
   336	    EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
   337	      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
   338	      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   339	        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
   340	        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
   341	    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
   342	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
   343	      local gout gexit=0
   344	      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   345	        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?
   346	      if jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$gout"; then
   347	        graders="$(jq -c '.graders' <<<"$gout")"; composite="$(jq -c '.composite' <<<"$gout")"
   348	      fi
   349	      if [[ $gexit -le 1 ]]; then status="completed"; err_json='null'
   350	      else err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"grader error"}'; fi
   351	      break
   352	    fi
   353	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 1 ]] && is_transport_failure "$ws"; then
   354	      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$attempt" '{type:"transport_error",message:"executor transport failure",attempt:$a}')"
   355	      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
   356	        keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" "-attempt1"
   357	        "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   358	        ws=""; executor='null'
   359	        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
   360	      fi
   361	    else
   362	      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson rc "$ex_rc" '{type:(if $rc == 2 then "infrastructure_error" else "agent_error" end),message:("execute-agent exit " + ($rc|tostring))}')"
   363	    fi
   364	    break
   365	  done
   366	  end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
   367	  if [[ -n "$ws" && -d "$ws" ]]; then
   368	    keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" ""
   369	    "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   370	  fi
   371	  jq -cn --arg run_id "$run_id" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg task_id "$task_id" \
   372	    --arg fixture "$fx" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson trial "$trial" --argjson attempts "$attempt" \
   373	    --arg status "$status" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg run_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
   374	    --argjson duration_ms "$(( end_ms - start_ms ))" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model_req "$MODEL" \
   375	    --argjson executor "$executor" --argjson graders "$graders" --argjson composite "$composite" \
   376	    --argjson error "$err_json" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" --arg digest_now "$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>/dev/null)" \
   377	    '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, batch: $batch, suite: $suite, task_id: $task_id, fixture: $fixture,
   378	      arm: $arm, trial: $trial, attempts: $attempts, status: $status, timestamp: $ts, run_date: $run_date,
   379	      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
   380	      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
   381	      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}
   382	     + (if $executor == null then {} else {executor: $executor} end)' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp"
   383	  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"
   384	}
   385	
   386	keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
   387	  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
   388	  mkdir -p "$dest"
   389	  for f in executor.json agent-output.json agent-stderr.log arm-removed.txt; do
   390	    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/$f" "$dest/$f"
   391	  done
   392	  for f in review.md audit.md; do [[ -f "$ws/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/$f" "$dest/$f"; done
   393	  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)
   394	  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"
   395	  return 0
   396	}
   397	
   398	# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
   399	collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
   400	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
   401	  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
   402	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
   403	    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
   404	    set_state failed; exit 3
   405	  fi
   406	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
   407	    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
   408	    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
   409	    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
   410	      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
   411	      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
   412	    else
   413	      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
   414	      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
   415	    fi
   416	    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
   417	  else
   418	    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
   419	    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
   420	  fi
   421	  write_status
   422	}
   423	
   424	log "start suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL trials=${#PLAN[@]} concurrency=$CONCURRENCY worktree=$WORKTREE"
   425	write_status
   426	trap 'log "interrupted"; set_state failed; exit 3' INT TERM HUP
   427	
   428	PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
   429	reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
   430	  local i
   431	  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
   432	    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
   433	      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
   434	        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
   435	        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
   436	        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
   437	        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
   438	        break
   439	      fi
   440	    done
   441	    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
   442	  done
   443	  return 0
   444	}
   445	
   446	n=0
   447	for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
   448	  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
   449	  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
   450	  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
   451	  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "$f" "$t" &
   452	  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PARM+=("$a")
   453	done
   454	reap 1
   455	
   456	total_done=0 total_failed=0
   457	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_done=$(( total_done + ${DONE[$i]} )); total_failed=$(( total_failed + ${FAILED[$i]} )); done
   458	if [[ $total_failed -eq 0 ]]; then
   459	  set_state complete; log "complete: $total_done trials"; exit 0
   460	elif [[ $total_done -eq 0 ]]; then
   461	  set_state failed; log "failed: no trial completed ($total_failed failed)"; exit 3
   462	else
   463	  set_state partial; log "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"; exit 1
   464	fi

diff --git a/evals/harness/execute-agent.sh b/evals/harness/execute-agent.sh

--- a/evals/harness/execute-agent.sh
+++ b/evals/harness/execute-agent.sh
@@ -51,7 +51,33 @@
 #   EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN     CLI executable                     (default: claude)
 #   EVAL_MAX_TURNS      --max-turns                        (default 40)
 #
-# Tested by evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
+# Control arms (cycle-129 FR-2, SDD D-2.1):
+#   LOA_EVAL_ARM          arm id (default baseline). Setting it at all is "arm
+#                         mode": the prompt tree's .loa.config.yaml is also
+#                         materialised so every arm sees the same config.
+#   LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES  JSON object {toggle: false, …}; when unset the arm is
+#                         resolved from LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, else from
+#                         evals/suites/<task dir name>.yaml (`ab.arms[]`)
+#   LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT  recorded as source_commit (default: the prompt
+#                         tree's HEAD)
+#   Toggles are applied to the SANDBOX COPY only, after every materialisation
+#   step and immediately before the executor starts; each is verified absent
+#   afterwards and a toggle that cannot take effect is exit 2 (an arm never
+#   silently runs as its baseline):
+#     companion_voice: false         flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
+#                                    in <ws>/.loa.config.yaml (yq)
+#     karpathy_block: false          '## Karpathy Principles' section out of
+#                                    <ws>/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md; Karpathy rows
+#                                    out of <ws>/.claude/data/constraints.json if present
+#     rule_files: false              stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of <ws>/.claude/rules/
+#     audit_delta_instruction: false the paragraph containing "look for what the
+#                                    review did not", else "Confirm the review's demotions
+#                                    independently", out of the sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md
+#   The appended skill prompt (.eval/skill-prompt.md) is derived from the
+#   toggled sandbox SKILL.md. executor.json records arm, arm_toggles,
+#   arm_evidence and source_commit.
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/execute-agent.bats and evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats.
 # =============================================================================
 set -euo pipefail
 
@@ -123,9 +149,140 @@ if [[ -d "$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/rules" ]]; then
 fi
 printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$WORKSPACE/CLAUDE.md"
 
-# Skill body without the YAML frontmatter → the appended system prompt.
+# --- 2b. control arm (cycle-129 FR-2) -----------------------------------------
+ARM_MODE=false
+[[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" ]] && ARM_MODE=true
+ARM="${LOA_EVAL_ARM:-baseline}"
+[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { echo "ERROR: invalid LOA_EVAL_ARM '$ARM'" >&2; exit 2; }
+if [[ "$ARM_MODE" == "true" && -f "$PROMPT_TREE/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
+  cp "$PROMPT_TREE/.loa.config.yaml" "$WORKSPACE/.loa.config.yaml"
+fi
+
+# The arm's toggles: explicit JSON, else the suite's ab.arms[] entry.
+resolve_toggles() {
+  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES:-}" ]]; then
+    jq -ce 'if type == "object" then . else error("not an object") end' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES" 2>/dev/null \
+      || { echo "ERROR: LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES is not a JSON object" >&2; return 2; }
+    return 0
+  fi
+  local suite_file="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-}"
+  if [[ -z "$suite_file" ]]; then
+    local tdir; tdir="$(basename "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")")"
+    [[ -f "$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml" ]] && suite_file="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml"
+  fi
+  local t="" found=0
+  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
+    found="$(ARM="$ARM" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(ARM))] | length' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
+    [[ "$found" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || found=0
+    if [[ "$found" -gt 0 ]]; then
+      t="$(ARM="$ARM" yq -o=json -I=0 '[.ab.arms[] | select(.id == strenv(ARM))][0].toggles // {}' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)"
+    fi
+  fi
+  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 || -z "$t" || "$t" == "null" ]]; then
+    [[ "$ARM" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
+    echo "ERROR: arm '$ARM' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (ab.arms[])" >&2
+    return 2
+  fi
+  printf '%s' "$t"
+}
+ARM_TOGGLES="$(resolve_toggles)" || exit 2
+
+# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
+# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
+_drop_md_section() {
+  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmp
+  tmp="$(mktemp "$eval_dir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
+  awk -v h="$heading" '
+    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
+    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
+    skip { n++; next }
+    { print }
+    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
+  mv "$tmp" "$f"
+  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
+}
+
+# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
+# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
+# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
+_drop_paragraph() {
+  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
+import re, sys
+path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
+paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
+for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
+    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
+        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
+            removed = paras[i]
+            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
+            del paras[i:i + 2]
+            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
+            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
+            sys.exit(0)
+sys.exit(1)
+PY
+}
+
+ARM_EVIDENCE='{}'
+_evidence() { ARM_EVIDENCE="$(jq -c --arg k "$1" --arg v "$2" '. + {($k): $v}' <<<"$ARM_EVIDENCE")"; }
+
+apply_toggles() {
+  local key val
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r key val; do
+    [[ -n "$key" ]] || continue
+    if [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then
+      echo "ERROR: arm '$ARM' toggle $key=$val (only false is defined)" >&2; return 2
+    fi
+    case "$key" in
+      companion_voice)
+        local cfg="$WORKSPACE/.loa.config.yaml"
+        [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || : > "$cfg"
+        yq -i '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice = false | .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice = false' "$cfg" \
+          || { echo "ERROR: companion_voice toggle: yq failed on the sandbox config" >&2; return 2; }
+        [[ "$(yq -r '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice' "$cfg")" == "false" ]] \
+          || { echo "ERROR: companion_voice toggle did not take effect" >&2; return 2; }
+        _evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
+        ;;
+      karpathy_block)
+        local k="$WORKSPACE/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
+        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { echo "ERROR: karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md" >&2; return 2; }
+        n="$(_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles')"
+        if [[ "${n:-0}" -eq 0 ]] || grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$k"; then
+          echo "ERROR: karpathy_block toggle: no '## Karpathy Principles' section removed" >&2; return 2
+        fi
+        local cj="$WORKSPACE/.claude/data/constraints.json"
+        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
+          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" && mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
+        fi
+        _evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md"
+        ;;
+      rule_files)
+        local r gone=""
+        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
+          if [[ -e "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
+          [[ ! -e "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { echo "ERROR: rule_files toggle: $r still present" >&2; return 2; }
+        done
+        _evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
+        ;;
+      audit_delta_instruction)
+        local s="$WORKSPACE/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
+        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { echo "ERROR: audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md" >&2; return 2; }
+        _drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
+          || { echo "ERROR: audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md" >&2; return 2; }
+        _evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
+        ;;
+      *) echo "ERROR: arm '$ARM' declares unknown toggle '$key'" >&2; return 2 ;;
+    esac
+  done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$ARM_TOGGLES")
+  return 0
+}
+apply_toggles || exit 2
+
+# Skill body without the YAML frontmatter → the appended system prompt. Read
+# from the (toggled) sandbox copy so an arm reaches the system prompt too.
 awk 'BEGIN{fm=0} NR==1 && $0=="---"{fm=1; next} fm==1 && $0=="---"{fm=2; next} fm!=1{print}' \
-  "$skill_src/SKILL.md" > "$eval_dir/skill-prompt.md"
